Two actual source abandonment stores reach 2; numeric cancellation leaves costs/targets and publishes no payment; re-opened prompt id differs; selected X2 spends 2 counters, pays no energy and dissolves the exact 2-spark physical enemy. 0-spark enemy remains. Source UUID, actual state/events, independent per-game persisted JSONL, control centre-hit/viewport geometry and raw empty Caps proved. Synthetic placeholders are lab fixtures. Numeric stale-intent rejection and enemy/reload semantics are headless contracts, not browser claims.
